page.layout: One printed page, rotated 90 degrees; running head at top with page number at top right. A tree diagram in the centre with braces, read from left to right in the rotated scan. Remnants of the facing page show at the left edge (not transcribed). Mark "C.F." at lower right.

main_text.l: Doctrina dicendi distribuitur in partes tres, in
Actionem eloquendi comitem, quæ est in
Memoriam, quæ custos est earum omnium.
Orationè, cuius partes sunt quatuor: quarum aliæ utuntur ad

page.notes: The diagram is rotated; the brace structure was read from the drawing, so the levels are my reading of the tree. The left edge shows show-through and the neighbouring page's text, which were left out. Some small words in the lower braces are faint and may need checking.
